lessons.title: Öğrenme deneyimini anlat ve geri bildirim iste
lessons.objective: Önceki bir denemeyi ve gelişen zorluğu belirt, açık bir geri bildirim sorusu sor ve yeniden deneme adımı belirle.
lessons.situation: Bir yetişkin kursunda yaptığın ilk görsel sunumu öğretmeninle değerlendiriyorsun.
lessons.bridge: Davranışı somutlaştır: I found it hard to … Ardından hangi geri bildirime ihtiyacın olduğunu ask for ile sınırla.

models.phrase: I found it hard to explain the first chart.
models.explanation: It, to explain ile açılacak görevi ileriye taşır. Hard burada zor anlamında.

models.phrase: Could you tell me which example was unclear?
models.explanation: Dolaylı soruda which example was unclear bir bütün. Doğrudan is/was ile ayrıca soru kurma.

concepts.label: Found it hard to + eylem
concepts.incorrect: I found hard to explain the chart.
concepts.correct: I found it hard to explain the chart.
concepts.explanation: Found it hard ardından to + yalın fiil. It, sonra gelen eylemi tutar.
guided: I found it ___ (hard / hardly) to answer the last question.
I found it hard ___ (to describe / describing) the first picture.
transfer: We found ___ hard to hear the instructions from the back.
She found it hard to ___ (justify) her choices in the interview.
delayed: At rehearsal I found ___ hard to speak without notes.
They found it ___ (easy / easily) to follow the second example.

concepts.label: Geri bildirim sorusunu somutlaştır
concepts.correct: At which point did my explanation stop making sense?
concepts.explanation: Kişilik veya genel beğeni yerine gözlenebilen bir işi ve yeri sor.
guided: Which question gives usable feedback on timing: “Did I rush the final step?” / “Was I good?”
Did I rush the final step?
Which asks how the listener understood a picture: “What did the arrows mean to you?” / “How old are you?”
What did the arrows mean to you?
transfer: You need to know where a listener got lost: “Which instruction was unclear?” / “Was I nervous?”
For a draft report, ask which comparison needs a unit: “Where should I add a unit?” / “Do you like the report?”
Where should I add a unit?
delayed: For a story, check cause rather than length: “Why did you think Mina left?” / “How many lines?”
Why did you think Mina left?
After a map rehearsal, check route choice: “Which turn did you expect after the bridge?” / “Was the map blue?”
Which turn did you expect after the bridge?

writing.prompt: Geçen hafta yaptığın kısa bir kurs gösterimini 75–105 sözcükle değerlendir. İki gözlem, bir hedefli soru ve yeniden deneme adımı ekle.
writing.sample: Last week I showed our group how to repair a small hole in a jacket. Everyone saw the first stitch, but I found it hard to explain how to finish the thread. I moved too quickly and the people at the back asked me to repeat the last step. Could you tell me exactly where I stopped being clear? Next Wednesday I will use a larger needle and pause after each move, then ask one person to show the final step back to me.
writing.revision: Geri bildirim sorusunu tek gözlenebilir davranışa odakla ve tekrarın işe yaradığını nasıl anlayacağını ekle.
criteria: Deneyimde somut zorluk ve güçlü yan ayrı.

input.text: Learning journal. On Tuesday I explained a chart with three bars. I spoke slowly at the start, but the group could not see what the green bar meant. My partner said the caption was too small. She also noticed that I did not pause after asking a question. Next time I will label the bars directly and give the group time to answer.
reading: Öğrenci renkli sütun sorununu nasıl düzeltecek?
input.transcript: Tutor: What did you find hard about the chart? Learner: People could see the bars, but I lost them when I changed units. Tutor: Show one unit at a time. Could you also pause before you show the final value? Learner: I can try that. Which example made the change easiest to follow? Tutor: The one about a family’s weekly budget.
input.preparation: Zorluğu ve öğretmenin iki önerisini ayır.
main: lost them when I changed units

retry.text: Workshop note. Please bring one rough draft. Underline a part that worries you. Ask a partner one question about that part, then revise it.
retry.transcript: I gave the recipe another go. I wrote the oven temperature on the board. This time everyone knew when to turn the oven on, but two people still mixed up the bowls. Next time I will use bowls of different colours.
retry.preparation: Düzeltilen ve süren sorunu ayrı dinle.
main: when to turn the oven on

lessons.readingPurpose: Hata, geri bildirim ve yeni denemeyi ayrı satıra al.
lessons.readingUse: Yeni görev için işe yarayacak bir danışma sorusu yaz.
lessons.listeningUse: Güçlük ve en yararlı öneriyi bir arkadaşına aktar.
lessons.speaking: Bir arkadaşına son denemende gerçekleşen bir olayı anlat. Partnerin belirsiz geri bildirim verirse hangi adımı değiştireceğini netleştiren takip sorusu sor.

recovery.reading: Sorunla çözümün aynı olduğundan emin ol.

grammarStrands: find it + sıfat + to ve hedefli soru
